goal: Insert location keys and verify interpolation at a real frame
preconditions: Authorized target obj exists; adapt its reference and restore any production frame/state as needed
code:
import bpy
obj=bpy.data.objects.get('RecipeQuad');assert obj is not None
obj.location.x=0;obj.keyframe_insert(data_path='location',frame=1)
obj.location.x=2;obj.keyframe_insert(data_path='location',frame=11)
bpy.context.scene.frame_set(6);bpy.context.view_layer.update()
assert abs(obj.location.x-1)<1e-5
result={'frame':6,'location_x':obj.location.x}
